slices.focus: A spring squall becomes the first real test of the revised process — backup cards, cargo tags, and same-day schedule recovery all hold up under real pressure.
slices.summary: A spring squall tests the revised process under real (moderate) pressure. Backup notice cards are in place, emergency cargo tags are ready, and a same-day schedule is posted much faster than the old baseline. Clinic-bound boxes get onto the first feasible sailing — the moment Ayaka realizes the system protects real needs, not just terminal neatness. She compiles a one-page summary with timestamps, a cargo example, and remaining limits.
open_loops: Success is under moderate conditions — heavier weather may still expose gaps
One-page summary could be dismissed by management as anecdotal
Ayaka may over-invest defending this result instead of iterating
